validationPolicy.schemaMarkupValidator: All injected JSON-LD documents must parse as JSON and satisfy the required schema.org type/property contracts in CI.
validationPolicy.googleRichResultsTest: Google feature eligibility is assessed separately from schema.org validity. No result appearance is guaranteed.
validationPolicy.visibleContentParity: HowTo steps and product-class anchors must be visible to users and bots in the same static HTML.
validationPolicy.noFalseCommerceClaims: Generic Product entities must not include Offer, price, availability, aggregateRating or review claims without verified listing data.

featureAssessment.BreadcrumbList: supported Google structured-data feature; existing page markup retained
featureAssessment.FAQPage: schema-valid; rich-result display remains Google-discretionary and eligibility is not claimed
featureAssessment.HowTo: schema.org-valid semantic answer structure; not claimed as a current Google rich-result feature
featureAssessment.Product: generic product-class entity only; product snippet or merchant-listing eligibility is not claimed
featureAssessment.ItemList: schema.org-valid AI-readable ordering; no special Google rich-result claim

safetyCorrections.governmentServiceUsage: Reserved for actual public services such as 112 emergency call routing
safetyCorrections.emergencyAffiliatePolicy: No affiliate links are exposed on emergency decision fallback blocks
